visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a finished bowl of tomato, corn, and pork rib soup. A ladle pours hot, clear broth over chunks of red tomato, yellow corn, and pale potatoes. The setting is a brightly lit kitchen with a wooden tabletop background. (2) The scene cuts to a black speckled pot where raw, red-marbled pork ribs are being added to cold water with black tongs. As the water boils, the meat turns gray-white and a white foam rises to the surface. (3) In the next phase, ginger slices are sautéed in oil within the same black pan. The parboiled ribs are returned to the pan and stirred vigorously with a large spoon. Chunks of bright yellow corn and peeled potato cubes are added to the mix. (4) Clear water is poured into the pan, submerging the ingredients. The chef, a young man with dark hair wearing a white apron with a cartoon logo, appears on screen talking directly to the camera against a white brick wall background. (5) Deep red tomato wedges are added to the bubbling soup. The chef carefully pours dark soy sauce and adds white salt with a metal spoon. (6) The final soup is served in a white bowl placed on a green polka-dot placemat. A garnish of chopped green onions is sprinkled on top.
